hooks.prompt: The session is ending. Read the recent conversation, .ai/memory/memory-index.md, .ai/PROJECT_STATUS.md, and .ai/context if present. If meaningful work happened, update durable .ai/memory via commit_memory, update PROJECT_STATUS.md/open-items, and update .ai/context only for verified repo navigation drift. If the session was trivial, call publish_result with a brief summary. Preserve user intent and do not invent learnings. Context: $ARGUMENTS

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d=process.env.AI_DIR||p.join(process.cwd(),'.ai');if(fs.existsSync(d)){const t=p.join(d,'temp');fs.mkdirSync(t,{recursive:true});const s={timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),event:'pre-compact'};for(const f of['PROJECT_STATUS.md','memory/memory-index.md','sessions/open-items.md','context/START_HERE.md','context/CODE_MAP.md','context/INVARIANTS.md']){const fp=p.join(d,f);if(fs.existsSync(fp))s[f]=fs.readFileSync(fp,'utf-8').slice(0,1800)}s.instructions='After compaction, preserve the latest user intent. Reconcile meaningful learnings into .ai/memory and verified repo navigation drift into .ai/context.';fs.writeFileSync(p.join(t,'pre-compact-dump.json'),JSON.stringify(s,null,2))}"

hooks.prompt: Compaction just happened. First read .ai/temp/pre-compact-dump.json if it exists. Restore the user's latest intent, check .ai/PROJECT_STATUS.md and .ai/context/START_HERE.md, then continue the task. If the compaction revealed stale memory or navigation context, update .ai/memory via commit_memory and update .ai/context only with concise verified changes. Context: $ARGUMENTS

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d=process.env.AI_DIR||p.join(process.cwd(),'.ai');if(!fs.existsSync(d))process.exit(0);try{const{execFileSync}=require('child_process');const s=execFileSync('git',['diff','--name-only'],{cwd:p.resolve(d,'..'),encoding:'utf-8'});if(s.includes('.ai/')){console.log(JSON.stringify({additionalContext:'Sub-agent made .ai/ changes. Consider running sync_memory to persist them.'}))}}catch{}"
